scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend,ingestion -c blue,green,magenta "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:ingestion"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace apps/frontend && cd apps/backend && ./mvnw package
scripts.setup: npm install && npm run setup:infra && npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:ingestion
scripts.setup:ingestion: cd apps/ingestion && python3 -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip && .venv/bin/python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace apps/frontend && cd apps/backend && ./mvnw test
